en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own numbers and rebuild the Australia versus New Zealand funds test for a master’s with a working spouse
en.runTitle: Jakarta to Australia or New Zealand: a master’s for her, work rights for him, on IDR 650 million

fields.label: Programme and university
fields.value: A 2-year master’s in accounting or data analytics, starting in 2027

fields.label: Partner’s age, job and English level

en.template: Help me compare {countryA} and {countryB} for a master's with a working spouse. I have {savings}, my programme options are {programme}, and my partner is {partner}. Rebuild the visa funds test, the two-year budget and the partner work-rights comparison with my numbers, mark anything unconfirmed or assumed, and show how much funding I still need to find with and without my partner's income. Ask before contacting anyone or paying anything.

phases.title: Read the official visa, funds and exchange-rate pages in both countries
phases.judgment: It kept unconfirmed figures labelled as unconfirmed. The New Zealand partner-visa fee and processing time had no official figure, so they were left open rather than guessed, and a law firm’s living-cost numbers were flagged as the first thing to verify.

phases.title: Write the guide with tuition, rent and a two-year budget in dollars and rupiah
phases.judgment: It caught a rule change that shapes the whole plan: since 2 October 2026 an Australian student-visa applicant cannot bring a spouse unless an exemption applies, and Indonesia is on the ASEAN exemption list. Because the official pages do not define “eligible”, it marked this to be checked with a registered migration agent or Home Affairs.

phases.title: Check every money figure and source, and re-run the check after the last edit
phases.judgment: After the final edit the check was run again: 0 mismatches across 60 money figures. Fees beyond one Brisbane university, Melbourne rents and priced listings stay marked “not found” instead of being filled in.

workers: Read New Zealand’s student visa, partner work visa and post-study work visa pages, plus the minimum wage
Pulled central-bank exchange rates, income tax tables, minimum and award wages, and public transport fares for both countries
Read Australia’s student visa rules: spouse inclusion, funds, fees, processing, work rights and the post-study graduate visa
Collected dated tuition fees for two-year master’s programmes and official rent figures for Brisbane, Auckland, Wellington and Melbourne
